name: OKC_K_KEY_TERM_EXTRACTS
description: This table captures the history of extracted Key Terms for a Contract.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the extracted key term.

columns.name: DNZ_CHR_ID
columns.description: Reference to the unique identifier of the contract header.

columns.name: MAJOR_VERSION
columns.description: Reference to the contract major version.

columns.name: SUBMITTER
columns.description: User who submitted the Key Term Extraction scheduled process.

columns.name: VERIFIED_FLAG
columns.description: OBSOLETE:This flag enables visibility of extracted key terms at each contract version; Possible values Y/N. Default is Null, we don't to populate any data for this without a Key Term record.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: SUBMIT_DATE
columns.description: Stores the time stamp when the request was submitted.

columns.name: RESULT_DATE
columns.description: Stores the time stamp when the request was completed.

columns.name: LATEST_FLAG
columns.description: This flag indicates that this the lastest submission of the Key terms extraction process for the current contract.

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_DATE
columns.description: Date when key terms are classified.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
